description: Orderbook snapshots with zero bids, zero asks, or both empty. Tests handling of illiquid markets where no counterparty is available. Includes transitions between normal, one-sided, and completely empty books.

expected_behavior.execution: must NOT submit market orders when asks (for buy) or bids (for sell) are empty; must cancel pending orders
expected_behavior.risk_system: should refuse to price positions when both sides are empty; use last valid mid-price with STALE flag
expected_behavior.spread_monitoring: thin_liquidity state has 2% spread (49500-50500) which exceeds normal threshold; should flag as WIDE_SPREAD
expected_behavior.alerting: should fire ZERO_LIQUIDITY alert within 500ms of detecting empty book side
expected_behavior.position_sizing: should reduce max order size proportionally to available liquidity depth
expected_behavior.recovery_detection: should detect recovery state and resume normal execution within 1 second
